name: 完了率と最新状態・子目標による進捗のダッシュボード
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized product UI screenshot of the goal progress dashboard shown in the supplied reference crop. Follow the same compact composition and the provided Japanese mock.

Keep the original structure: two equal summary cards side by side across the top. The left card is Goal completion with a large bold 0% and the line 「上半期・2026年の終了まで6か月」. The right card is Latest status with an outlined empty status circle, bold 「状態なし」, and a green text action 「状態を設定」. Use subtle light-gray borders and rounded corners.

Under the cards, show a progress section header on the left with a small yellow lightning icon, then the warning icon and 「子目標が接続されていません」 beside it. Align a small sliders/settings icon and 「進捗の設定」 at the far right.

Place a wide, uncluttered progress chart below. Show a thin mint vertical today marker at the left labeled 「今日」. The y-axis labels are 100%, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0%. The x-axis runs from 1月 at the left through 7月 at the right, with 「2026年」 under January. Draw very light horizontal grid lines and a pale-gray forecast region rising linearly from 0% in January to 100% in July. No actual progress line or data points.

At the bottom, show the help sentence 「子目標を使って、この目標の進捗を自動で更新します。」 and one green button with a plus icon labeled 「子目標を接続」. Include no other controls or content.

Use crisp Japanese glyphs and the established Meiryo typography: regular 14/24 for labels and body text, 12/16 for chart/supporting text, and bold 20/28 for section headings or key values. Keep chart labels readable and secondary. Preserve the sparse, calm Asana-like layout and the 1.585:1 crop composition. No surrounding page chrome, no added whitespace, no English copy, no decorative effects.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at 1579x996 (1.585:1), matching the 1168x737 source crop at 1.585:1. Japanese dashboard labels, two summary cards, progress warning and settings, Jan–Jul linear forecast chart, help text, and green connect-subgoal button are present with no extra blank bands. Exact Meiryo metrics and pixel-level alignment remain unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
